metadata.question: Did Dallasport, Washington reach air temperatures of at least 95 degrees fahrenheit in July 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Dallasport, Washington (need to find coordinates) - Time period: July 2022 (2022-07-01 to 2022-07-31) - Collection: ERA5-Land or ECMWF temperature data for air temperature - Need to check maximum temperature for the month 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5/ECMWF reanalysis data (it's modeled data, not optical imagery) - Just need to extract temperature values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Temperature of 95°F = 35°C = 308.15 K - ERA5-Land provides temperature in Kelvin - Valid temperature range: ~250-330K for surface air temperature - If result is None/Null → C3 - If no images found → C1 - If temperature >= 308.15K at any point in July → A (Yes) - Otherwise → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Dallasport, Washington coordinates const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.1784, 45.6184]); const startDate = '2022-07-01'; const endDate = '2022-07-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // ERA5-Land hourly data for 2m air temperature const collection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(point) .select('temperature_2m'); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log("No data available for July 2022."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get maximum temperature const maxTemp = collection.max(); // 4. Calculate maximum temperature at the point const tempStats = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: point, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxTempK = tempStats.temperature_2m; // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (maxTempK === null || maxTempK === undefined) { console.log("Temperature calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit: F = (K - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32 const maxTempF = (maxTempK - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32; console.log(`Max temperature in July 2022: ${maxTempF.toFixed(2)}°F (${maxTempK.toFixed(2)}K)`); console.log(`Threshold: 95°F (308.15K)`); if (maxTempF >= 95) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
